purpose.primary: Provide a small formal teaching abstraction inspired by RTT state, flow, resonance, update, and continuity structures.
purpose.formal_goal: Represent a state, represent an update, apply the update component-wise, and inspect selected transition and preservation properties.
purpose.educational_principle: A small formal transition model can make change and persistence inspectable without claiming to formalize the complete source framework.

zero_update.name: zeroUpdate
zero_update.expected_property: Applying zeroUpdate preserves the original state.
zero_update.educational_role: Provide a simple formal example of complete preservation under a neutral update.

zero_update_property.meaning: Under the supplied component-wise update definition, adding zero to every represented state component leaves the state unchanged.

continuous_from.name: ContinuousFrom
continuous_from.conceptual_definition: The supplied update applied to the before-state produces the declared after-state.
continuous_from.purpose: Provide a small explicit formal relationship for tracing a declared state transition.

continuous_from_boundary.means_inside_teaching_model: The after-state is obtained by applying the represented update to the before-state.
does_not_mean: empirical continuity of a physical system

example_transition.interpretation: Each represented update component changes its corresponding represented state component.
questions: What changed?
What remained structurally identifiable?
Which update component corresponds to which state field?
Can the after-state be traced directly to the before-state and update?

formal_targets.claim: The flow component changes according to flowChange.

formal_targets.name: Resonance Update Correspondence
formal_targets.claim: The resonance component changes according to resonanceChange.

formal_targets.name: Zero Update Preservation
formal_targets.claim: Applying the represented zero update preserves the state.

formal_targets.name: Declared Transition
formal_targets.claim: An after-state satisfying the represented update relation is ContinuousFrom the before-state under the local teaching predicate.

structural_continuity.lesson: Structural continuity can remain even when every represented component value changes.

value_continuity_vs_structural_continuit.value_continuity: A particular component retains the same value.
value_continuity_vs_structural_continuit.structural_continuity: The component remains identifiable in the state model and retains its update correspondence.
value_continuity_vs_structural_continuit.principle: A state can change numerically while preserving formal structure.

awareness.question: What state fields, update fields, and transition rules are actually represented?

coherence.question: Does this hold together?
coherence.formal_answer: The declared after-state can be checked against the explicit component-wise update definition.

clarity.question: Can this be understood and inspected?
clarity.formal_answer: The reduced state/update structure exposes exactly how each represented component changes.

continuity.question: What persists through change?
continuity.formal_answer: The component structure and update correspondences may persist while component values change.

history_boundary.purpose: Allow recurrence, drift, and pattern breaks to be inspected over multiple transitions.

formal_origin_sequence_summary.lesson: Extract a generic structure without claiming complete source equivalence.
Preserve an undefined source relationship instead of inventing convenient semantics.
Make named contributions and their composition explicit.
Verify selected consequences of a deliberately simplified signed relation.
Expose algebraic structure added by formalization.
Represent change as an inspectable state-transition relation while preserving the boundary of the teaching model.
